rules.statement: Under Section 26 of the Mortgage Act, substitution of heirs can be made in respect of a deceased co-mortgagor even where such co-mortgagor had died before the action was filed provided the action was not a nullity.
rules.supporting_quote: "The question whether the whole decree in the latter case is a nullity can only be answered after considering the nature of the action."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 26 of the Mortgage Act No. 6 of 1949
